title: Two people die trying to cross Channel from France
summary: French authorities say about 100 people were attempting to reach the UK on a makeshift boat Two people have died while trying to cross the Channel to Britain, French authorities said. The incident occurred south of the beaches of Neufchâtel-Hardelot, when about 100 people were trying to get to the UK on a makeshift boat. French authorities said about 60 others attempting the crossing had been rescued. Continue reading...
